_schema: Candidate codename registry (2026-08-28, user directive: 'memorable names for candidates, perhaps word chains'). APPEND-ONLY; names are never reused or reassigned. Scheme: two-word chains; a PAIR configuration chains its members' second words (north-anchor + river-lantern => anchor-lantern). 'lodestar' is the reserved PROGRAM name for the unified-ship-candidate track (W12-U); its winner is codenamed at freeze.

north-anchor.role: PROFILE C (SDR) — frozen into the zensim crate 2026-08-29 (user-directed); prior: frozen SDR candidate-of-record

river-lantern.role: retired map champion (superseded by amber-lantern, user-adopted 2026-08-29)

clear-ember.role: campaign cid22 champ + best G-GRAN v2 dial calibration

aurora-anchor.role: PROFILE CHdr (HDR) — frozen into the zensim crate 2026-08-29 (user-directed); BHdr stays shipped default

lodestar.role: PROGRAM: the W12-U unified ship candidate track (rank+dial+map in ONE bake; stems LSTAR_s*)

amber-lantern.role: ADOPTED steering-map companion of record (user 2026-08-29; dual-instrument pick, loop 0.256/-1.52%)

anchor-amber.role: ADOPTED companion configuration of record (user 2026-08-29): north-anchor scores, amber-lantern steers (jxl; map env opt-in unchanged)
